sources.excerpt: Red Muck mk.2 by Jam Pedals | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Jam Pedals Red Muck mk.2 LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ BOOSTER DISTORTION Description Inspired by the ’71 “triangle” and the later “Red Army / Civil War” Muffs, the Red Muck boasts a wider gamut of saturation and varied degrees of compression and sustain on tap. The Boost footswitch engages a dedicated section of the circuit, separately tuned to hit the front end of the Red Muck and generate even fatter walls of Fuzz-Distortion or with the Gain set lower, function as a High-Gain-Stage footswitch.
